# Step Definition Pattern Analysis Skill

## Purpose
Analyze existing step definition files to extract coding patterns, naming conventions, and reusable structures.

## Analysis Capabilities
- Scan existing step definition files in tests/step_defs/
- Extract function naming patterns (snake_case, prefixes, suffixes)
- Identify parameter handling approaches
- Analyze import statement structures
- Detect page object integration methods
- Extract decorator usage patterns (@given, @when, @then)

## Pattern Detection
- Common step function prefixes/suffixes
- Parameter naming conventions
- Function organization within files
- Error handling patterns
- Documentation styles (docstrings)

## Output Format
- Pattern summary with examples
- Naming convention rules
- Code structure templates
- Integration guidelines
